design: Public purposive pilot; freeze before first scored core comparison, no protected holdout
primary_contrast: calculation_only versus scope_gated on missing-bridge and strict-JSON controls; same floating-point algorithm in both
hypothesis: Removing an explicit missing-evidence gate causes false acceptance on authored missing-bridge controls; adding the gate does not fix numerical instability
baseline_constraints: Public structured task only; never reference labels, expected_response or criteria. Built-in known counterexample patterns; not general reasoning agents.

float_tolerance.note: Baseline tolerance heuristic only; exact rational references use equality

excluded: scored=false open question retained in raw rows
intervals: Wilson 95% descriptive only under hypothetical iid Bernoulli assumptions; no population inference or superiority p-value on this purposive dependent set
no_tuning: No labels or task selection changes after first core scored run; any future change requires version bump and preserved previous artifacts
no_AI_claim: Baselines are deterministic engineered controls, not paid APIs, LLMs or deployed scientific verification systems
system_evaluations: Separate capability protocols with no pooled leaderboard; source snapshots and exploratory reference-error correction disclosed
